description: Details for one product, by slug (from search_catalog) or by any of its variant SKUs: description, colors with images and availability, sizes, the size chart (garment measurements), fabric specs, construction details (pockets, zippers, hood, drawcords, cuffs, hems, a visible maker logo), and how well it takes each decoration method (screen print, DTG, embroidery, sublimation, heat-transfer vinyl, discharge, DTF). Pass `color` to also get that color's sizes, each with its SKU and availability, and that color's own fabric blend. A detail the description and fields do not state is not listed, not absent: say "not listed" and point to the product page photos, never "no". Yes/no fields read yes, no or not_listed; each construction yes or no carries the maker's quote or the photo that shows it.

color.description: A color name exactly as listed in `colors`.

sku.description: A variant SKU from get_product (called with a color).

name: get_product
title: Get product details
